prefs.title: My gaming preferences
prefs.private: They're private: they don't show on your profile and are only used to find players compatible with you.
prefs.empty: Tell us how you like to play and we'll show you compatible players.
prefs.valuesHint: Describe how you play; it can't be used to rate other people.

setup.title: Set up your gaming preferences
setup.text: Tell us your play times, platforms and how you like to play so we can work out how compatible you are with other players.

noGames.title: Add your favorite games
noGames.text: We look for compatible players among people who play the same games as you. Add at least one favorite game to your profile.

empty.title: No compatible players yet
empty.text: Nobody who plays the same games as you has set up their preferences yet. Add more favorite games or check back later.

error.title: Couldn't load compatible players
error.text: Check your connection and try again.
